decision_audit.decision: Treat only a real external Claude/Gemini/human verdict file as scoped packet evidence, not as V3 major release authorization.
decision_audit.different_path_now: Use this intake guard to record scoped packet evidence while the major V2.x performance gate remains the actual release authority.
decision_audit.foolish_actions: The foolish action was accepting a scoped external review as V3 release authorization instead of only as evidence for the 13-row packet.
decision_audit.other_path: A looser path could rely on prose discipline alone, but that already created release-boundary confusion.
decision_audit.was_i_foolish: Yes. The prior intake translated a scoped release_ready verdict into release_authorized true, which skipped the major performance mandate.
